project.title: AsOf
project.short_description: AsOf checks each policy claim in an AI assistant's answer against the policy version in force on the customer's date, stops answers that contradict it, and keeps a tamper-evident Db2 record of what was said and why. Built for the kind of failure at issue in Moffatt v. Air Canada.

members.name: Jay Malhotra
members.role: Solo developer: design, Db2, AI pipeline, UI

features_used: Bitemporal tables (BUSINESS_TIME and SYSTEM_TIME periods, history table)
FOR BUSINESS_TIME AS OF and FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF queries
Native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) with VECTOR_DISTANCE in the same query as temporal predicates
Indexes, foreign keys and check constraints
Least-privilege Db2 users with explicit grants
